To take over a hostile starship, you must first board it and kill the crew.

Once the crew is dealt with, enter the ship's pilot seat to take it over. If you want to make it your home ship, you can use the Ship section of the Data Menu, or simply start using it. (Hyperspace Travel, landing on a planet, or fast traveling will automatically make it your home ship.)

A captured ship cannot be sold or modified until it has been registered, which you can also do from the Ship section of the Data Menu (for a fee).
